    triage[Triage request]
    answer[Send answer]
  end

  subgraph Engineering
    investigate[Investigate issue]
    fix[Prepare fix]
  end

  triage -->|Known issue| answer
  triage -->|Needs code change| investigate
  investigate --> fix --> answer
  answer --> receive
